levels.title: Create a Table for New Artists
levels.task: The label wants to keep track of new artists they meet. Help them by creating a new table called new_artists with columns for name, genre, city, and state. All of the columns will be varchars, then query your table to see the new columns.
levels.hintMessage: Use CREATE TABLE and define four columns with types. Don’t forget to include the character count for varchar: VARCHAR(100).
levels.successMessage: Table created! Your team can now log all the up-and-coming talent.

levels.title: Insert a New Artist
levels.task: A new artist named Luna Ray just got scouted! She’s a pop singer from Austin, TX. Add her info to the new_artists table then query the table.
levels.solution:
INSERT INTO new_artists (name, genre, city, state)
VALUES ('Luna Ray', 'Pop', 'Austin', 'TX');
levels.hintMessage: Insert values into all four columns. Remember that strings need to be in quotes and that the row of data should be surrounded by parenthesis.
levels.successMessage: Nice work! Luna Ray has officially been added.

levels.title: Insert Multiple Artists
levels.task: You’ve just met two more artists: Blaze Carter (Hip-Hop, Detroit, MI) and Isla Sky (Indie, Portland, OR). Add them both in one statement.
levels.solution:
INSERT INTO new_artists (name, genre, city, state)
VALUES
('Blaze Carter', 'Hip-Hop', 'Detroit', 'MI'),
('Isla Sky', 'Indie', 'Portland', 'OR');
levels.hintMessage: Use commas to separate rows in your insert and each row should be surrounded with parenthesis.
levels.successMessage: Awesome! Your table is growing with fresh new talent.

levels.title: Create a Table for Song Submissions
levels.task: The team needs a table to track demo submissions. Create a demo_songs table with song_title, artist_name, and submission_date. Then query the table to see the new columns.
levels.successMessage: Great! Now they can keep track of demo submissions easily.

levels.title: Add Demo Submissions
levels.task: You’ve received two demos: “Sunset City” by Luna Ray (2024-06-01) and “Bounce Back” by Blaze Carter (2024-06-02). Add them to the demo_songs table.
levels.solution:
INSERT INTO demo_songs (song_title, artist_name, submission_date)
VALUES
('Sunset City', 'Luna Ray', '2024-06-01'),
('Bounce Back', 'Blaze Carter', '2024-06-02');
levels.successMessage: Done! Your entries are live in the system.
